data.title: KSrelief Signs Cooperation Memorandum to Provide Healthcare to Patients and Injured People Worldwide
data.content:
Riyadh, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) signed a memorandum of cooperation on Thursday with Sanofi Arabia Trading Company Limited to provide healthcare to patients and injured people around the world.
    Under the memorandum, essential vaccines will be provided to populations in countries with limited immunization programs or facing public health challenges.
    It will also support prevention and public health initiatives to protect vulnerable populations from infectious diseases, in line with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and international health security objectives.
    The memorandum will also strengthen Saudi Arabia’s role in regional and global health security and explore sustainable models linking locally developed healthcare capabilities with humanitarian efforts to strengthen health systems in countries in need.
    This reflects Saudi Arabia’s leading role in international humanitarian work and its efforts to expand its reach while advancing KSrelief's humanitarian mission.
    -- SPA
